entry.title: New: chrome-faithful#dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful
entry.summary: Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port. Exact install spec: github:bpc-oss/chrome-faithful#path:/packages/dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
